entry.title: Loyalty apps frustrate Toronto coffee drinkers
entry.summary: Customers of several Toronto coffee shops say loyalty apps keep logging them out, and some are switching to cafés with simple punch cards.

entry.title: Cold brew subscriptions grow among Toronto offices
entry.summary: Office managers in Toronto are signing cold brew coffee subscriptions as staff return to downtown towers.
